g.title: crate Arvane native backend for top-level and embedded child windows.
crate::a11y Converts accepted shell semantics to the native AccessKit adapter.
crate::contacts Maps winit contacts and native metadata to portable pointer input.
crate::cpu The softbuffer CPU surface of a window and whether it shows a frame.
crate::detached Records whether this crate ever detached a thread that may still run its code.
crate::display Initial window placement and display frame pacing.
crate::display::placement Chooses the first window's monitor and centers the window in its work area.
crate::display::refresh Turns a monitor's reported refresh rate into a frame period.
crate::display::windows Read the Windows monitor work area for initial window placement.
crate::embed Native child window creation in the host event loop.
crate::embed::child Share embedded child commands and implement the host handle contract.
crate::embed::geometry Checked logical to physical child sizing.
crate::embed::session Own the embedded handler and share failure, shutdown and negotiation.
crate::embed::windows Win32 embedded children, owned by the host GUI thread.
crate::embed::windows::a11y UIA messages and state publication.
crate::embed::windows::bridge Synchronous UIA adapter, independent from application callback borrows.
crate::embed::windows::cpu CPU present through a cache DC clipped below higher siblings.
crate::embed::windows::create Validates the Win32 parent and creates the child window on its GUI thread.
crate::embed::windows::dpi Thread-scoped parent DPI awareness, never process-wide settings.
crate::embed::windows::ime Child-window IMM32 composition and candidate placement.
crate::embed::windows::input Win32 mouse normalization, keyboard text and synchronous cursor answers.
crate::embed::windows::native Keep Win32 identity, message ids and the host-facing Backend below dispatch.
crate::embed::windows::proc Win32 dispatch with an independently retained Rc on every entry.
crate::embed::windows::services Native dialog ownership and shell file drops for embedded windows.
crate::embed::windows::state UI-only callback state, separate from synchronous wndproc answers.
crate::embed::windows::target Raw presentation target; retaining it never destroys a host window.
crate::embed::windows::test_parent Real Win32 host window for embedding end-to-end tests.
crate::embed::windows::window Embedded ShellWindow services and synchronous CPU/GPU presentation.
crate::module Keep library code mapped while its threads or providers may still run.
crate::native_input Native input handling and translation.
crate::native_input::locale Reads the current system locale.
crate::native_input::state Stores native input and IME state.
crate::native_input::system Portable queries of system input settings and file-drag tracking.
crate::open Opening and revealing file paths.
crate::runtime Main-thread event loop and lifetime-bound CPU surface.
crate::services Window-owned clipboard and native file dialog services.
crate::wait Bounded shutdown waits on a native window's owning thread.
crate::wheel Converts native wheel notches to logical scroll distances.
